messages:
eli (AE): Heads-up: Aurora Health CFO wants an "acceptable risk" slide + commercial fallback for tomorrow's executive sync. Primary asks: KMS approach, egress throughput/SLA, and procurement-ready retention language. Can we assemble by EOD?

jordan (SE): Quick KMS summary: Private = BYOK (CloudHSM / Azure KeyVault). Hosted = envelope-key model (customer wrapping key + Redwood-managed root); direct HSM in Hosted is an exception and needs exec signoff.

net-bot: NET ticket NET-5333 created for VPC peering to 10.100.64.0/22. ETA 24-36h.

noor (Infra): Peering in review. If they need guaranteed egress throughput, we can commit on Dedicated reserved pools (example SLA: 250 Mbps sustained, 1 Gbps burst) but not on Hosted public egress. If peering delayed we have a secure S3 presigned + SQS ingestion fallback; I'll draft a 5-step runbook.

rachel (Legal): I'll need exact KMS + retention sentences for the addendum and SOC2 link. Draft wording suggestion: "Private deployments support customer-managed keys (CloudHSM or Azure KeyVault) and Redwood will not have the ability to decrypt customer ciphertext. Hosted deployments support envelope-key integration; inclusion of HSM-backed keys in Hosted requires a written product exception and executive approval." Approve?

syl (Solutions): Approve wording. Also propose commercial fallback options: (A) Private + Reserved Dedicated pool: 12% discount on a 2-year commit + migration credit. (B) Hosted + Redwood-managed envelope keys with a +3-4% security uplift and short SLA for peered flows if we provision a dedicated egress path.

jordan (SE): For the slide bullets I suggest:
- Transport: TLS1.3 for control plane; mTLS for peered flows
- KMS: BYOK for Private; envelope-key for Hosted (HSM in Hosted = exception)
- Egress: Dedicated = reserved throughput SLA; Hosted = best-effort; fallback via secure S3/SQS
- Logging: 90d default; extendable via contract
- Compliance: SOC2 report available; addendum will reference DPA

eli (AE): Carter, want to join the CFO call if they escalate?

carter (VP Sales): Yes, I can join. If procurement pushes on Hosted-only requirements, escalate to me and I'll loop infra and legal.

rachel (Legal): I'll attach the SOC2 link and add the KMS sentence to the addendum. Please confirm the final slide before I send.

noor (Infra): I'll upload the runbook PDF and a one-slide diagram in 60m. NET-5333 status will be updated when approved.

eli (AE): Thanks team. Action items: runbook + slide from Infra; final bullets from Jordan; addendum from Rachel; commercial fallback numbers from Syl. Due by 18:00 PT today (2026-03-24). I'll consolidate and send to the customer contact (emma@aurorahealth.com). Closing thread once slide is posted. :rocket:
